'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Rick Moller LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rick Moller]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
